text.title: Grocery delivery in Moscow for busy families
text.removed: A shop floor the customer walks through
text.replacement: A photo stock list with live availability
text.reason: 18 interviews: people lose time choosing items on the floor
text.risk: Impulse buys drop; the app suggests add-ons to replace them
text.check: Average basket size and add-on rate, reviewed monthly
text.decision: Launch the banner from 1 October; check basket size after 4 weeks
